raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Physical dimensions of the cantilever cuboid",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 7 determines L=16a, W=H=2a from equal coarse cubes, but never specifies their edge length a or physical units. The aspect ratio is determined.",
      "readings": [
        "a=1 length unit: domain 16×2×2, fine-element edge 1/16.",
        "a=1/16 length unit: domain 1×1/8×1/8, fine-element edge 1/256."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Load centered on the right-hand face",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Section 7 places the z-directed load in the middle of the right face and refers to unavailable Fig. 2(a). It does not distinguish a concentrated nodal force from a distributed load or specify a footprint and force weights.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated force at the center node (L,W/2,H/2).",
        "Equal forces on the nine face nodes with y/W and z/H in {15/32,16/32,17/32}, normalized to a prescribed resultant.",
        "Uniform traction on the centered patch 3/8≤y/W≤5/8 and 3/8≤z/H≤5/8, assembled as consistent nodal forces."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Polarity of the z-directed load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Section 7 specifies the z direction without an explicit signed component; the arrow in Fig. 2(a) is unavailable. Reversing this sole load leaves compliance and the optimal density unchanged in linear elasticity.",
      "readings": [
        "Force acts along +z.",
        "Force acts along -z."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Resultant force on the right-hand face",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Section 7 nor the CANT-16-2-2-5 description supplies a force or traction magnitude. Table 1's objective values cannot identify it independently of the other missing inputs.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant magnitude F=1 in consistent force units.",
        "Total resultant magnitude F=10 in the same units, with the same spatial distribution."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Allowed material volume",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Equation (1) specifies sum(rho_i)=V, but no numerical V or volume fraction is supplied for this example. The plotting fractions and density cutoffs in Figures 3–5 do not specify V.",
      "readings": [
        "With upper density normalized to 1, V=0.2m.",
        "With upper density normalized to 1, V=0.4m.",
        "With upper density normalized to 1, V=0.5m."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Upper density bounds",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Equation (1) introduces upper bounds rho_upper, but Section 7.1 supplies only the lower bounds. No numerical upper bound or full-density normalization is stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform upper bound rho_upper_i=1.",
        "Uniform upper bound rho_upper_i=2, holding V in the equation's density units fixed."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Overall elastic stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper defines generic element stiffness matrices K_i without giving Young's modulus or an equivalent overall scale for the elasticity tensor.",
      "readings": [
        "Reference elastic modulus E_ref=1 in consistent units.",
        "Reference elastic modulus E_ref=10 in the same units, with the normalized elasticity tensor unchanged."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Normalized elasticity tensor, including Poisson coupling and material symmetry",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sections 1 and 6.2 specify stiffness properties and finite-element bases, but no constitutive tensor, isotropy assumption, Poisson ratio, or material-axis orientation.",
      "readings": [
        "Homogeneous isotropic elasticity with Poisson ratio 0.30.",
        "Homogeneous isotropic elasticity with Poisson ratio 0.25.",
        "Homogeneous orthotropic elasticity aligned with x,y,z, with C/E_ref=diag(2,1,1,0.4,0.4,0.4) in engineering-shear Voigt order xx,yy,zz,yz,xz,xy."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Integration used to construct the hexahedral element stiffness matrices",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 6.2 determines trilinear hexahedral displacement elements and elementwise constant density, but does not specify stiffness quadrature or an integration modification.",
      "readings": [
        "Fully integrated Q1 hexahedra using 2×2×2 Gauss quadrature.",
        "For isotropic elasticity, selective reduced integration: one-point volumetric integration and 2×2×2 integration of the deviatoric term."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial PBM penalty parameters for the Table 1 PBM rows",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 3.2 gives initial primal variables and multipliers, penalty reduction factors, and penalty floors, but not initial p_i, q_lower_i, or q_upper_i.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize all three penalty-parameter vectors to 1.",
        "Initialize all three penalty-parameter vectors to 0.1."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PBM Newton backtracking configuration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 3.2 and Algorithm 2 prescribe an Armijo backtracking search without specifying the sufficient-decrease constant, contraction factor, or initial trial step.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial step 1, Armijo constant 0.0001, contraction factor 0.5.",
        "Initial step 1, Armijo constant 0.01, contraction factor 0.8.",
        "Initial step 0.5, Armijo constant 0.0001, contraction factor 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Gauss-Seidel smoothing within the multigrid preconditioner",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 6.1 names Gauss-Seidel smoothing but does not give pre/post sweep counts, sweep ordering, or scalar versus nodal-block updates.",
      "readings": [
        "One lexicographic scalar forward presweep and one reverse-order scalar postsweep.",
        "Two lexicographic scalar forward presweeps and two reverse-order scalar postsweeps.",
        "One forward and one backward sweep using 3×3 displacement blocks at each node."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Multigrid coarsest-level solver",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 6 specifies Galerkin coarse operators and a V-cycle, but does not specify how the coarsest system is solved.",
      "readings": [
        "Solve the coarsest system directly by Cholesky factorization.",
        "Approximate the coarsest solve with ten symmetric Gauss-Seidel iterations starting from zero."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MINRES residual measurement",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Equation (31) gives a relative residual test with unsubscripted norms. It does not explicitly distinguish a true Euclidean residual check from the preconditioned residual estimate used by an implementation.",
      "readings": [
        "Check ||b-Az||_2 / ||b||_2 explicitly.",
        "Check the corresponding preconditioned residual norm or its MINRES recurrence estimate."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial guesses for successive MINRES solves",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 6 gives MINRES tolerances but does not state whether linear solves start from zero or reuse previous solutions. The outer PBM/IP initial values do not specify initial Newton increments.",
      "readings": [
        "Start every linear solve from zero.",
        "Reuse the previous displacement in DOC and the previous Newton increment in PBM/IP."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial DOC density distribution",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sections 3.2 and 4.1 explicitly initialize PBM and IP densities uniformly, but Section 5 and Algorithm 4 do not specify a DOC initial density.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform density rho_i=V/m.",
        "A feasible volume-preserving perturbation: half the cells at V/m+epsilon and half at V/m-epsilon, with epsilon=0.1 times the smaller distance from V/m to the uniform density bounds."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial stored values for the shifted IP barrier update",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Section 4.1 initializes r=s=0.01, but Algorithm 3 first assigns r=r_plus and s=s_plus on line 4 before line 11 has initialized those stored values.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize stored r_plus=s_plus=0.01 as well.",
        "Initialize stored r_plus and s_plus from the initial complementarity measures multiplied by 0.2, while retaining r=s=0.01 for the first Newton solve."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
